bug_class: containment and trust-boundary mistakes across modules (checks made on a different form of a path than the one used: after template variable substitution, case-insensitive lookup, plugin hooks and separator/portable-name normalisation; per-tenant isolation of cache and export state; canonical tenant names)
summary: sitesmith, a toy multi-tenant static site builder (templates with includes, asset bundling, render cache, plugin hooks, szip export/import) driven by a command script: eight places decide containment on an earlier or different form of a path than the one actually opened, or share state between tenants, so requests are not refused with the documented DENIED/ERROR lines and the program's own invariant check (exit 86) fires or another tenant's data leaks into the output.
